overview: 公司于2026年进行首次公开募股（IPO），并在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市，公开发行145,696,000股新股。本年度没有其他业务板块扩张、缩减或合约相关的公告。
overview_en: The company conducted an initial public offering (IPO) in 2026 and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad, with a public issue of 145,696,000 new ordinary shares. There were no other announcements related to business segment expansion, reduction, or contracts during the year.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成IPO并在ACE市场上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR LISTING ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") C
actions.text: 进行首次公开募股，公开发行145,696,000股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市。
actions.text_en: Conducted an initial public offering comprising a public issue of 145,696,000 new ordinary shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
